scope: Raft single design system, pinned @botiverse/raft-ui 0.10.5 (import alias raft-ui); modes light/dark/system. Semantic recipes owned by official package.

families.rule: Use native size/variant/state recipes. Defined defaults are allowed; unexplained page overrides are not.
Local detail dismissal uses the official component, preserving navigation and unresolved-write guards. Loading/error branches follow the same rule.
Keep container focus return, Escape and dismissal fences. Do not replace with generic detail close.

families.owner: official PickerTriggerButton or the source toolbar's Button parameters
families.rule: Reuse the owning toolbar recipe, not a form-field selector. Task and memory filter adaptation does not redefine all filter sizes.

families.owner: official FieldSelectTrigger and raft-ui form primitives
families.rule: Use the field family with its labels, validation and disabled state; no toolbar-sized substitutions.
Preserve hover/touch disclosure, disabled/pending semantics and composer event rules. Do not bulk-convert ghost to outline.

families.owner: official sidebar / segmented / tree / disclosure components
families.rule: Native HTML buttons are allowed when structurally ported from the matching source. A row or back arrow is not a submit or X-close action.

families.owner: official dialog/action primitives and feature authorization
families.rule: Variant conveys priority; preserve existing confirmation, revision and unknown-result handling. Do not infer business rules from a button label.

families.owner: raft-ui PanelAction within official Agent profile header
families.rule: Only the registered instance profile close uses native PanelAction; desktop action hidden below md, mobile uses native back. No size/variant override. Preserve Escape, opener focus and unknown-write guards.
families.sourceRevision: v1.21.22 af3d6ef4a22f0f05f5f9db9424285755d67e9726 / AgentDetailPanel-B3FrpUPj.js il; page-adoption instance-inspector-chrome

families.rule: Native comment toggle icon-lg ghost/outline and desktop sidebar/mobile sheet; Loom binds existing attachment comment owner. Published PDF permits whole-file discussion only, forces null anchors and displays scope. Cross-origin viewer unchanged; no page/selection annotations.

families.owner: official SearchHeader / SearchEntityResult; Loom data-router presentation binding
families.rule: Input query and its clickable layout commit atomically; preserve native click, IME, filtering, keyboard rail and background-location semantics. Only input updates use data-router flushSync; network requests remain asynchronous.

families.owner: @botiverse/raft-ui 0.10.5 native typography/control sizes, SearchTrigger, ListRowGroup/ListRow and DescriptionList; official page wAt / AgentProfileEditDialog composition
families.rule: Use pinned production source recipes; no new size system. Fine-pointer desktop typography only; explicit message tier remains user-owned. Role field writes use immutable Role revisions. Existing instances become out of date; they are never silently changed.
exceptions: Loom Role prompt/runtime fields compose native DescriptionList with existing catalog validation. Avatar picker supports official pixel presets; image upload is not enabled without a Role upload-intent binding.
Existing approved compact mobile adaptations remain; this release does not broaden desktop typography to coarse-pointer tablets.

families.owner: raft-ui InboxItem compact / InboxItemTrigger / InboxItemActions reveal=hover
families.rule: Official v1.21.26 compact row composition. Trigger owns row navigation, trailing action owns done; touch action remains visible, keyboard focus returns to trigger. Activity preview840px, search unaffected.

Complete pinned source owns list metadata, static/interactive states and label/value recipes. Loom supplies instance identity, runtime labels, navigation, and unknown values; no cloud machine store. Editable ComputerProfile is a separate inline-edit scenario.

families.owner: Raft Sidebar mobileInline settingsGroups / MobileComputersPanel ListRow composition
families.rule: Desktop computer rail remains independent; mobile-only Settings link opens computer list, then detail. Use SidebarItemIcon and native ListRow/IconTile recipes; retain Loom local identity and connection status.
families.adoption: Structural port of conditional navigation and mobile row composition, not byte-exact whole page; cloud registration/version/disk controls omitted.

families.owner: Locked db5e399 EntityResultRow / SearchHomeEntityRow / ThreadsInbox empty JSX / TaskModalHead / ShowMoreToggle
families.rule: Generate source presentation and retain native recipes, description measurement and expansion. Loom owns queries, mutations, focus-return ref and supported activity filters.
localDifferences: Explicit imports bind Loom TaskProperties and existing local avatar/identity/locale helpers; no upstream task or query controller adopted
EntityResultRow adds rootRef for context-menu focus return and data-entity-id for the stable keyboard/navigation rail
Activity read filter only maps supported mentions/unread/all; other upstream filters omitted
families.limits: Generated boundaries are not whole-page equivalence; query state, overlays and task modal composition remain local.

families.rule: Generate native presentation and explicitly bind Loom TaskBoardActions. Permission and pending/unknown state disable both keyboard status control and drag initiation; local backend remains the sole task owner. VirtualizedTaskStack and TaskVirtualLayout share the single official context.
localDifferences: TaskCard controller replaced by useTaskCardActions; busy forwarded to status editor
DraggableTaskWrapper combines caller disabled with Loom canEditStatus and busy
Official cloud task/page stores excluded; only selected display declarations extracted
families.limits: Task page composition/filtering/create flow remains local; source hashes and license in source-lock.json.

exceptions.owner: owner-approved compact mobile adaptation, preserved by AGENTS.md
exceptions.rule: Retain owner-approved compact headers and composer layout; rUI 0.6 owns icon geometry and hit area. Mobile primary pages use PanelSectionHeader and its layer-frame/on-frame tokens; detail headers use PanelHeader. Root title and trailing text count use the 16px content edges, not centered groups or trailing icon overhang. Do not reintroduce the old custom close pseudo-element.
Memory filter buttons adopt current task-toolbar parameters; this is not a global replacement of PickerTriggerButton or form fields.

exceptions.owner: official task mobile full-screen navigation; retained Loom task presentation
exceptions.rule: The mobile control labelled close is a back arrow; preserve its Button outline and navigation semantics rather than replacing with an X.

limits: Bindings identify ownership and review scope; listing a file is not visual acceptance.

Guards enforce local detail closures, registered action provenance, absence of per-action size/variant overrides and mobile selector semantics; they do not prove every control in every theme conforms.
Frozen upstream components retain their own contracts. Changing their DOM adaptation requires a scoped integration check.

formSave.rule: Full configuration form submit, md accent.
formSave.adoption: local parameter binding; native recipe, not byte-exact copied page

formCancel.rule: Full configuration form cancel, md outline.
formCancel.adoption: local parameter binding; native recipe, not byte-exact copied page

dialogSave.rule: Compact creation or selection footer, md accent.
dialogSave.adoption: local parameter binding; native recipe, not byte-exact copied page

confirmDelete.rule: Destructive confirmation, native default md danger.
confirmDelete.adoption: local parameter binding; native recipe, not byte-exact copied page

confirmChange.rule: Explicit disruptive change confirmation, md warning variant.
confirmChange.adoption: local parameter binding; native recipe, not byte-exact copied page

recovery.rule: SearchResultsBoundaryFallback retry, md outline; same role for Loom receipt verification.
recovery.adoption: local parameter binding; native recipe, not byte-exact copied page

secondary.rule: Secondary compact dialog/content action, native md outline.
secondary.adoption: local parameter binding; native recipe, not byte-exact copied page

menuIcon.rule: Icon-only menu uses native icon-md recipe; preserve existing ghost interaction.
menuIcon.adoption: local parameter binding; native recipe, not byte-exact copied page

sourceDependency.rule: Byte-exact source; no edits in upstream snapshot. Compatibility entry points only forward props; PanelHeader retains approved mobile placement via data attributes and mobile.css. Retired uppercase prop is discarded by SectionEyebrow adapter. Both raft-ui import names resolve to one runtime.

appearancePage.scope: Exact declaration extraction, not whole module execution. Existing device preference store and MessageItem preview retained; no upstream account, billing or server stores.

roleProfile.scope: Exact AgentHeaderName/InfoRow/style-constant extraction; structural composition of official hero, description and separated property groups. Loom maps configuration to Role, omits nonexistent handle/live status, retains immutable revision and field editors. No upstream business stores execute.
roleProfile.compositionSource: AgentDetailPanel hero lines 3167–3234; AgentProfileInfo description lines 1807+, info/runtime blocks lines 1958+/2088+ at pinned db5e399
roleProfile.localDifference: Role model and effort edited together using published binding-specific options; existing immutable revision save. Default selected tab Profile; Activity remains first in tab order; profile includes native instance member list after a separated section. Local Role semantics and inline editors retained.

roleActivity.scope: Exact official LogItem and timeline recipes. Local read-only adapter merges member-scoped existing diagnostic pages and labels rows by frozen instance display name. PickerTriggerButton owns filter trigger. No upstream store/socket and no inferred task state.
roleActivity.bounds: 50 records per source, concurrency 4, most recent 100 rendered in aggregate; single-source cursor pagination. Visible named failures; active view only.

roleEntryParity.rule: Profile when available, independently of tab order
roleEntryParity.binding: loom/AgentPage.tsx: roles maps to official profile
roleEntryParity.scope: Role page initial entry and list selection; not instance avatar inspector

dateTimeSourceParity.scope: Exact date/time JSX subtree; explicit synchronous device preference callbacks. Loading flags false because storage is synchronous; warning slot receives local storage error. Chinese-only language block remains Loom composition; no upstream account or translation store introduced.
dateTimeSourceParity.localCompatibility: Select uses browser sentinel for empty inherited timezone; adapter restores empty draft and null persistence. Avoids placeholder replacing effective timezone label.

releaseNotesSourceParity.scope: Exact content JSX children and category declarations; Loom typed static release list supplies ready state. Existing SettingsPage owns header/scroll. No upstream fetch, store or duplicate header; old Vite exposeReleaseNotes path removed.

settingsSectionsSourceParity.exact: System channel JSX unchanged. About version section with product rename/test marker. Account profile and notification subtrees retain native layout with explicit omissions and guards. Not untouched whole SettingsPanel.
localChanges: Omit cloud account email/identity/password/signout, omit avatar email absent from Loom identity
Keep account editingDisabled fence and maxLength=120
Omit upstream desktop/mobile downloads and workspace billing identity
Omit upstream notification server-wide mute; retain local details/recovery actions
Preserve loading/error/confirmed notification guards; green badge requires confirmed subscription
FormField/AvatarSlot bindings remain; SettingsProfileCard/SurfaceListItem/SlugInput now directly depend on exact official source
settingsSectionsSourceParity.removed: Four runtime SettingsPanel transforms, loom-native-appearance module and account/system virtual aliases

localDifferences: Archive type label is channel, not upstream public/nonmember; original local permission and write controller retained
Settings sidebar omits cloud feedback unread dot, Loom supplies supported category entries
FormField retains type-only legacy labelStyle argument ignored; official FieldLabel owns style
FormField i18n fallback binds existing local message catalog; archive timestamps bind existing time formatter
Settings shell still owns local routing, draft preservation and mobile master-detail; no claim of whole native shell extraction
